rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a material structural template: acknowledge and endorse a board's submitted document, explain how the board-associated international program advances peace and freedom while countering Soviet influence, praise the board's contribution, and close with personal appreciation. C05 has a similar commission-commendation and statutory-program narrative, but it concerns completed administrative work rather than endorsement of a board report or principles. C04 shares only the more generic committee-appreciation form.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have read with interest the resolution adopted by the Board of Foreign Scholarships
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am impressed by the report of the Advisory Board on International Development.
shared_material.explanation: Both open by acknowledging and favorably evaluating a document submitted by an international-program advisory board.

shared_material.child_excerpt: this program...is proving effective in combatting communist lies and distortions
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Economic stagnation is the advance guard of Soviet conquest...economic development is the spearhead of the forces of freedom.
shared_material.explanation: Both frame an international educational or development program as an affirmative instrument against communist influence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am pleased to accept the resolution...to approve the principles it embodies and to reaffirm my unqualified support
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am sure that your report will do a great deal to put the problem...in its proper perspective...your report will be of great help
shared_material.explanation: Each letter endorses the board's submitted work and connects it to continued executive policy support.

shared_material.child_excerpt: thank the members of the Board for their outstanding public service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Please accept my deepest personal appreciation for the task which your Board has accomplished
shared_material.explanation: The closing commendation of the board and its public contribution follows substantially the same functional pattern.
